integrity: The nonexistence proof is analytic and applies to every symmetric 3-by-3 input: it derives simultaneous diagonalization on the diagonal subspace, exact second-order pole identities, a parity obstruction, and a final discriminant-square contradiction. The checker only corroborates algebraic identities and examples and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem resolves only dimension 3 for the exact size-6 symmetric linearization requested in the source. It does not decide dimensions at least 4 or rule out different spectrahedral representations that do not realize the six permutation pairings as one pencil spectrum. Literature searches can miss unindexed or differently phrased work.
